nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Measure: The lanes seem familiar, but the last ends against the fence. Maybe you miscounted.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Measure: You lose count halfway. The track stays open; nothing stops you walking across it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The goalposts stand a little beyond the marked field.

choices.text: See if you remember this place.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Measure: The posts are level. The painted line is crooked. Or you started at the wrong end.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Measure: You cannot hold both distances in your head. There is a seam in the paint you had missed.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Echo: This goal looks familiar. That feeling might be from another field.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: Echo: A shout almost comes back to you. No words. The posts are still there.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: There is old tape around one upright. The paint has worn through beneath it.

nodes.speaker: protagonist
nodes.text: The rest of the field is open. You can go back to the stands, or cross to the noticeboard.
